title: Power Rangers Season 29 Dino Fury Season 2
description: A team of teenagers with attitude are recruited to save Angel Grove from the evil witch, Rita Repulsa, and later, Lord Zedd, Emperor of all he sees, and their horde of monsters.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x1
episodes_data.description: Void Knight suddenly returns, and a new member of his vicious crew joins Slyther and Mucus in tricking the Rangers and stealing a valuable Dino Key.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x2
episodes_data.description: The Rangers must divide their fighting duties when Slyther and pirate robot Wreckmate challenge each other to see who can be more destructive.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x3
episodes_data.description: Solon's system gets an update. Javi, Izzy and the Rangers spot a Sporix beast — but not before evil Occulo tries to nab it first.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x4
episodes_data.description: Aiyon reconnects with a shrunken Zord, but Occulo and Wreckmate try chasing it down for Void Knight's secret plans.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x5
episodes_data.description: Izzy gets frustrated about the outfit her mom designed for the prom.  The Rangers battle a Sporix creature with an appetite for trash.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x6
episodes_data.description: Javi notices a powerful Dino Key on a band leader’s necklace. The Rangers power up to face off against Void Knight’s nasty new gizmo.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x7
episodes_data.description: Santaura convinces Void Knight and wicked Squashblight to contaminate the city’s water supply and turn all the residents into trees.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x8
episodes_data.description: The Rangers question Void Knight’s intentions. Santaura comes up with a new strategy to hunt down her former partner in crime.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x9
episodes_data.description: Amelia leads the crew on a search for a ghost caught on camera. A new robot programmed to crush and conquer hunts down the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x10
episodes_data.description: Aiyon and Izzy find a secret stash of cash — and a powerful necklace that turns creatures mega-sized.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x11
episodes_data.description: Javi must come up with a new tune after his song for a competition is stolen. Mucus suggests a fresh way to beat the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x12
episodes_data.description: When Jane vetoes a Buzzblast story on bigfoot, Amelia tells Stan and Annie to bend the rules and publish it anyway, but when her colleagues end up in danger, Amelia learns an important lesson about responsibility.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x13
episodes_data.description: Ollie tries to ask Amelia out, but a miscommunication leads to Amelia thinking he doesn't like her.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x14
episodes_data.description: The Ranger teens head to Rafkon to stop Lord Zedd, but because of a prophecy, Aiyon takes unnecessary risks.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x15
episodes_data.description: The other Morphin Masters are angry to discover the Green Morphin Master has broken their vow to never intervene in mortal affairs. But when the Rangers and the Green Morphin Master work together, the Morphin Masters have a change of heart.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x16
episodes_data.description: When a monster's meddling gives Javi a big break, he must come to terms with the fact that the key to success is hard work.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x17
episodes_data.description: Fern is offered a place at an elite sports college; Fern and Izzy's relationship is put to three test.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x18
episodes_data.description: Izzy is torn following Fern's acceptance to a faraway college. The Rangers try to stop Quickspine and Mucus from stealing Carlos' key.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x19
episodes_data.description: When Izzy and Javi are hit by blasts from a special weapon, they're brainwashed into helping the Void Queen with her plot to steal the Sporix.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x20
episodes_data.description: A band of Rafkonians arrive looking to colonize Earth, but the Rangers talk them into joining forces to stop the Void Queen's Sporix beasts.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x21
episodes_data.description: As citizens flee in the wake of the Sporix beast invasion, the Rangers find an energy cocoon created by the Void Queen that could destroy Pine Ridge.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Dino Fury Season 2 29x22
episodes_data.description: After Tarrick moves the energy cocoon outside of the city, the Rangers must do battle with the Void Queen and her massive Nemesis beast.
